raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Every reorg admission flag mirrors its bucket-file key exactly (`--max-waiting-requests` / `max_waiting_requests`, `--max-pending-prefill-tokens` / `max_pending_prefill_tokens`, `--max-running-usage`, `--max-kv-usage`), except the router-local in-flight cap: the flag is `--max-in-flight` while the group key is `max_inflight_requests`. Follow-up to the docs rewrite in #43592, where this came up as the one exception that had to be called out.

## Modifications

- `src/config/cli.rs`: the flag is now `--max-inflight-requests`; `--max-in-flight` stays a `visible_alias`, so existing launch commands keep working and `--help` lists both. Startup error messages name the new flag. Tests spell the new flag and one new assertion covers the alias.
- `src/config/types.rs`, `src/policies_reorg/factory.rs`: doc comments.
- `README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`: the key-flags row, the admission table, the in-flight sentence and Example A.

Internal field names (`EligibilityConfig::max_in_flight`, the legacy `overloaded` filter) are unchanged; this only renames the CLI surface. Rebased on main after #43592 (docs rewrite) and #44951 (router compile fix) merged.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A (CLI flag rename with alias; no routing behavior change).

Local: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test --lib config::cli` pass in `experimental/sgl-router`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

## Checklist

- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Add unit tests.

files.patch:
@@ -134,7 +134,7 @@ sgl-router --model-id qwen3 --chat-routing reorg \
   --worker-urls http://10.0.0.1:30000 http://10.0.0.2:30000 \
   --policy cache_aware \
   --affinity-mode prefer --cache-affinity-min-match-ratio 0.2 \
-  --max-waiting-requests 16 --max-in-flight 56
+  --max-waiting-requests 16 --max-inflight-requests 56
 ```
 
 - **Engines:** two plain engines; each handles both prefill and decode.

@@ -114,7 +114,7 @@ engine's [native gRPC](#native-grpc) API.
 | Model | `--model-id`, `--tokenizer-path`, `--no-tokenizer` |
 | Engines | `--worker-urls`, or `--service-discovery` with `--selector` (plain) or `--prefill-selector` + `--decode-selector` (P/D) |
 | Routing | `--chat-routing reorg`, `--policy`, `--bucket-config`, `--affinity-*`, `--session-id-header` |
-| Admission | `--max-in-flight`, `--max-waiting-requests`, `--max-pending-prefill-tokens`, `--max-running-usage`, `--max-kv-usage` |
+| Admission | `--max-inflight-requests`, `--max-waiting-requests`, `--max-pending-prefill-tokens`, `--max-running-usage`, `--max-kv-usage` |
 | Reliability | `--retry-max-attempts`, `--request-timeout-secs`, `--stale-request-timeout-secs` |
 | KV signals | `--cache-prefix-provider`, `--kv-indexer-endpoint`, `--kv-peer-selector` |
 
@@ -152,14 +152,14 @@ Admission flags set per-engine caps; an engine at a cap is skipped:
 
 | Flag | Rejects an engine at |
 |---|---|
-| `--max-in-flight N` | `N` requests this router has in flight to it |
+| `--max-inflight-requests N` | `N` requests this router has in flight to it (`--max-in-flight` is an alias) |
 | `--max-waiting-requests N` | `N` engine-reported waiting requests |
 | `--max-pending-prefill-tokens N` | `N` engine-reported waiting uncached tokens |
 | `--max-running-usage F` | share `F` of its reported running-request capacity |
 | `--max-kv-usage F` | share `F` of its reported KV capacity |
 
 Engine-reported caps lag by one load report, so a burst can pass them;
-`--max-in-flight` counts dispatches as they happen.
+`--max-inflight-requests` counts dispatches as they happen.
 
 For the full selection rules see ARCHITECTURE.md:
 [load-aware routing](ARCHITECTURE.md#13-example-load-aware-routing),
